Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that balanced forces explain the onset of motion and chose option A. Balanced forces produce no acceleration; an object starts sliding only when an unbalanced force overcomes static friction, causing acceleration. Therefore, the correct choice is B) An unbalanced force causes acceleration.
